title: Jumping Fresh Australian Basil Bake
description: A yeasty and springy Australian dish featuring fresh basil leaves, perfect for a dinner party. This gluten-free friendly bake is sure to impress your guests.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the gluten-free flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Add the olive oil, garlic, and chopped basil leaves to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased baking dish and top with shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake the dish in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the Jumping Fresh Australian Basil Bake hot, garnished with additional basil leaves if desired.
